title: Collapse internal Hom into a single target
statement: With C,J,R,L,N as in [def-sc-signed-sheaf-dual-complex], there is an isomorphism of integer cochain complexes internal Hom(L,single(N,0)) [def-pur-hom-complex] ≅ D(L,N). No boundedness, freeness or nonzero assumption is made.

source.place: Section 0A8X, section-hom-complexes, product Hom differential; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A8X

proof.text: Use the projections of lem-sc-hom-complex-projections. In degree k, every product factor except p=-k has a zero target. The projection to p=-k is invertible: lift the family with identity in that factor and zero elsewhere, and apply the product hom-ext principle to both composites.

Transport the surviving degree-zero target to N by singleObjXSelf. The projection differential formula has zero target differential, and its remaining term is -(-1)^k times precomposition. This matches the explicitly constructed signed dual. Assemble the degree isomorphisms with HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents. All these steps are proved in Lean.
